canonical_architecture.outer_graph: ai_statistician/agent_runtime.py is the sole typed research graph.
canonical_architecture.inner_loop: ai_statistician/client_tool_loop.py is the shared retained model-tool loop for Theory, Python/R, Simulation, Lean, and isolated review.
canonical_architecture.theory_state: Substantive mathematics lives in hash-bound Markdown/LaTeX files; JSON is limited to compact identity, dependency, checkpoint, and handoff envelopes. Exploratory Python/R scripts have no function/JSON-return ABI: exact source, raw output and errors are retained for model-owned interpretation and revision.
canonical_architecture.scientific_code: The source-owning model writes Python/R, executes the complete hash-bound single-file or multi-file project in the scientific sandbox, receives raw observations, and authors revisions in the same retained session.
canonical_architecture.formalization: Lean is selected by frozen task intent. It is mandatory for formal tasks and optional or advisory otherwise; only exact target-bound kernel promotion creates proof evidence.
canonical_architecture.collaboration: Architect resolves request-scoped evidence and genuine cross-workspace conflicts; ordinary feedback stays with its source owner. Current outer execution is serial/interleaved; dual_track is a dependency policy, not implemented parallel scheduling.
canonical_architecture.source_use: Literature, code, and data are model-selected and hash-bound under an explicit source horizon. Replication identity binds raw streams, declared result hashes, post-run workspace state, errors, and undeclared artifacts; only a clean run can reach success gates, and no run is automatic authority for theory or prose.
canonical_architecture.codex_adoption: Reuse OpenAI Codex invariants such as retained source ownership, capability-accurate stable tools, raw observations, file-backed state, isolated review, and sparse handoffs. Do not embed Codex Core, App Server, provider transport, SDK threads, worktrees, Guardian, or a second scheduler.
canonical_architecture.native_model_capacity: One typed thinking option in the existing pinned-Haiku request/transport. Enabled requests use automatic tool selection and preserve opaque signed/redacted content; plain-text stopping still requires explicit continuation, never automatic acceptance or resampling.

current_design_assessment.direction: The same source-owning model interprets complete environment observations and authors scientific revisions. Independent artifact review now explicitly uses its own rubric without taking over whole-project completion; the original question remains intact for target fidelity. Full-task acceptance still independently requires every frozen evidence dimension and terminal acceptance. Permissions, identity, blinding, independent review and kernel authority remain enforced. Scientific mistakes alone justify neither runtime error rules nor benchmark-specific prompt recipes. The instruction change is not evidence of improved mathematical judgment or research-E2E acceptance.
correct_boundaries: No runtime-authored statistical, mathematical, Python/R, or Lean repair content.
No RepairAgent, hidden post-runtime workflow, whole-packet regeneration loop, or second scheduler in the canonical path.

Theory uses persistent Markdown/LaTeX and model-selected source, scratch, edit, checkpoint, and gap actions; fresh JSON handoffs carry only claim/path references and executable ABI, never duplicated mathematics.
Scientific code and Lean use direct environment feedback in the same source-owner session.

Independent reviewers inspect immutable artifacts and report findings without editing source; post-runtime gold accepts their aggregate status only when its row hash and runtime evidence graph hash match the exact current result.

A complete research loop requires both its task-intent-selected evidence and an outer AgentRuntime terminal status of ACCEPTED; hidden-gold derives that conjunction independently instead of trusting the summary boolean, while component evidence remains visible for incomplete graphs.

Formalization is intent-driven and cannot erase accepted non-formal evidence when it is not required; formal completion is revalidated against the exact frozen-target kernel-promotion artifact rather than an aggregate boolean.
remaining_risks: Metric authoring, compact context projections and some role prompts remain oversized. The deleted feedback blacklists are not a general cleanup of all contracts; further simplification needs a demonstrated shared defect, not another field rule, packet type or case-specific instruction. Ordinary observations never grant tool permissions or evidence authority.

Keep it opt-in and frozen before a future run. Authorized local .env configuration is available; no historical credential recovery is needed.

Long-horizon mathematical judgment and independent-referee falsification remain unreliable under exact Haiku. Latest internal acceptance failed independent theory, code and empirical gold despite 77 reviewer/Critic turns.

This has no fresh efficacy evidence and does not resolve the label disagreement or justify a content rule. Preserve every attempt without rerun, relabeling, scope reduction or another topic chosen merely to obtain a pass.
General publisher-paper, data and dependency/environment reconstruction remains incomplete; prepared frozen projects and scientific WASM runtimes do not establish arbitrary reproduction.
Outer graph is serial; dependency-selective revalidation and true isolated concurrent work need measured, scoped implementation within the existing runtime.
Formal execution and retrieval must use the same active checkout. Broad cross-version discovery context is not an accessible active-project premise or exact theorem closure.

Verified cross-task library growth and learned research/tactic policies remain unestablished; retrieval and training-data export are not learning evidence.
Legacy baselines and historical audit utilities remain non-authoritative; the package and runtime are near structural regression ceilings, so expansion requires consolidation.

Change the harness only for a demonstrated shared authority, state, tool, or feedback defect.
